desc: 短款抽绳廓形配袖侧撞色织带，暗场霓虹秀场视觉卖个性
leaf: 撞色织带短款抽绳连帽卫衣
name: 撞色织带短款抽绳卫衣款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒立住街头秀场调性，用暗场加硬轮廓光把短款廓形和袖侧织带打成记忆点。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline slot reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF display type with a stacked outlined echo, one short label reading 「{callout_1}」 in #E5372A under it

shots.intent: 用硬切双拼色块把整件衣服的侧面剪影一次讲清，一秒传达短款露腰的比例主张。
shots.textZone: top band headline slot reading 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF, one small side label reading 「{callout_2}」 in #0B0B0F

shots.intent: 先戳普通卫衣没型没态度的痛点，再用同款剪裁同光线并排，把差异交给眼睛看。
shots.textZone: one two-line label block reading 「{callout_3}」 above the left panel in #F2F0EA, one single-line slot reading 「{selling_point_3}」 above the right panel in #FFFFFF with a #E5372A underline rule

shots.intent: 把衣服放回夜街场景，让买家代入穿搭状态并验证短款比例上身效果。
用侧光微距证明布面与走线的质感，替买家完成摸面料这一步。
shots.textZone: one label line under the frame reading 「{selling_point_4}」 in #FFFFFF at 16pt led by a plus glyph

shots.intent: 后侧45度拍帽型、绳头、肩缝与罗纹收口，把做工结构讲成可视证据。
shots.textZone: two short leader-line labels reading 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」 in #E5372A at 14pt, one per feature

shots.intent: 平铺正俯视加数据卡与尺码表结构，消掉选码与版型疑虑，数值后期合成避免错渲。
shots.textZone: top section title slot reading 「{callout_6}」 in #FFFFFF with an outlined echo; right column holds a bordered data card with a rounded header bar in #E5372A and six label rows in #FFFFFF, plus a compact size table below with a rounded header bar and three rows

shots.intent: 三张错落相框同光同角展示多配色与叠穿状态，让买家自己选款留人。
shots.textZone: one vertical headline slot reading 「{selling_point_5}」 in #FFFFFF beside an outlined echo in #E5372A

shots.intent: 以同一视觉体系收口，用色块楔形与按钮引导点击，不靠虚构优惠。
shots.textZone: headline slot reading 「{selling_point_6}」 in #FFFFFF at 40pt in the upper third, one rounded button reading 「{callout_7}」 in #0B0B0F on a #F0C22E field in the lower third

style.backgroundSystem: ink field #0B0B0F carrying a hairline grid, stacked outlined display type at low opacity, torn paper edges and tape strips; or a hard two-tone split panel built from #F0C22E and #24357C with no gradient
style.direction: editorial streetwear lookbook poster on a detail page
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular language: one ring-shaped rotating label motif, one circular plus magnifier badge, hairline leader rules to labels
style.lightingSystem: two-light setup: large soft front key plus a hard accent rim from behind-left, deep soft falloff, one honest contact shadow under any laid or standing garment, never floating
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent editorial streetwear detail-page visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of ink field #0B0B0F, paper highlight #F2F0EA, headline text #FFFFFF, one signal accent #E5372A, and two split-panel blocks #F0C22E and #24357C; cool-neutral key with one warm rim; condensed industrial display sans-serif for headlines with a modern geometric sans-serif for labels, one family system only, no mixing; backgrounds built from the ink field #0B0B0F with a hairline grid, stacked outlined display type, torn paper edges and tape strips, or a hard two-tone split panel with no gradient; two-light setup of a large soft front key plus a hard accent rim from behind-left, deep soft falloff, one honest contact shadow, no floating garment; thin-line circular icon language with one ring-shaped rotating label motif and one circular plus magnifier badge; product always on-body or laid flat at true scale with real weave depth and no plastic sheen, silhouette never stretched or slimmed; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand wordmarks, no QR codes.
noDrift: no source brand marks, store names or QR codes
no invented numbers, certifications or discounts
style.presentationRules: garment shown on-body or laid flat at true scale, angle family held across the set, sleeve tape and cropped hem always readable, fabric rendered with real weave depth and zero plastic sheen, model face never a direct identifiable portrait
style.surfaceSystem: matte dark studio floor #14141A or seamless paper sweep; wet asphalt only on the outdoor scene screen
style.temperature: cool-neutral key with one warm rim
style.typography: condensed industrial display sans-serif for headline slots and a modern geometric sans-serif for labels, one family system only, Chinese copy always wrapped in corner brackets, headline 28-48pt, label 10-16pt, max three text moments per screen
